Subject: Re: Checkout failures and 504s in us-west — urgent

Team — quick findings:
- Root cause candidate: proxy weight rebalance at 06:45 pushed a small set of backends above their steady TTL; health checks were borderline and a subset started returning 502s. Client retries are being proxied aggressively and we observed request amplification (retry storms) on a subset of LB frontends.
- Evidence: p95_traces_usw.png (attached), support_logs_1205.zip contains repeated request ids and backoff timestamps.

Mitigation plan (immediate):
1) Hotfix proxy config to reduce retry-on-502 to 0 for 15 minutes and disable aggressive retry headers. (5m)
2) Roll back weight rebalance for affected pool and drain suspicious backends. (10-15m)
3) If error rate persists after (1)-(2), flip Acme traffic to their reserved dedicated pool for 60 minutes to restore customer experience (coord with CS). (20m)

I'll run the hotfix now and post updates. Markus — please send the config-diff and flag any correlated deploy IDs.

-michael
Engineering Manager, Infra
Redwood Inference
